# Figure plan, MODEL v3.0.0 (generated by tools/design_docs_v3.py from figure_plan.py; do not edit by hand)

One registry (`figure_plan.py`) decides where every figure is written (`layout.figure`), which module of `figures/` draws it, and which data files it reads. **Compute / draw separation**: the model scripts write data only (tests/test_figures_v3.py greps them for plotting); `figures/` reads `outputs/data/` only, and `run_all.py --figures-only` checks that every data file is byte-identical before and after drawing.

**Formats** follow the run profile (`runprofile.py`): light, PNG at 200 dpi with the footer "LIGHT RUN — n=1000", under `outputs/_light/`; full, vector PDF and PNG at 600 dpi under `outputs/`. `outputs/FIGURES.md` is written by `indexes.py` from the same registry and the figure audit records.

**Sign rules** (`figures/draw.py`). Time series: positive bands stacked up from zero, negative bands (Overbuild absorbed, Unconsented additions, Released dwellings (TL)) stacked down from zero, the net a black line. Cumulative bars: each negative band an unfilled, unhatched segment outlined in its band colour, hanging from the top of the positive stack, so the bar ends at the net total, marked with a tick. Material and stage values are never negative (`draw.nonnegative` stops the run). Only the recent replacement surge is hatched. **Boundaries**: AR a solid line, AtP a dotted line, with the three zones below AtP, between AtP and AR and above AR, in every figure of PB_FIGURES: Fig3_reference_boundaries, Fig4_pathways_annual, Fig5_waterfall, Fig6_solution_space, ED7_waterfall_ambitious, ED9_rollout_timing, ED13_replacement_variants, D21_fan_and_boundaries, D22_boundaries, D23_annual_loe, D24_headroom, D25_annual_carbon_by_band, D26_cumulative_carbon_by_band, D27_variants_vs_boundaries, D28_pathways_annual. **Maintenance** (B2, B4) is drawn as its own layer only in Fig2_reference_carbon, Fig3_reference_boundaries, Fig5_waterfall, ED7_waterfall_ambitious, D25_annual_carbon_by_band, D26_cumulative_carbon_by_band, D32_tl_staircase, D36_pathway_bands. The palette is the registry of `figures/style.py` ([PALETTE.md](PALETTE.md)); no colour repeats within a group.

## Paper, main (`outputs/paper_main/`)

### Fig1. Floor area: history and projection by demand band

* File: `Fig1_floor_area` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `baseline/bands_history.csv`, `baseline/bands_annual.csv`, `baseline/annual.csv`
* Draft caption: Floor area built per year, history (census intervals) and the Reference projection 2026-2050, by demand band: positive bands stacked up from zero, negative bands (overbuild absorbed, unconsented additions) down from zero, the net a black line.

### Fig2. Embodied carbon of the Reference

* File: `Fig2_reference_carbon` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `baseline/bands_annual.csv`, `baseline/annual_by_material.csv`, `baseline/annual_by_stage.csv`
* Draft caption: Annual embodied carbon of the Reference 2026-2050 by (a) demand band, (b) material and (c) life-cycle stage; materials and stages are never negative.

### Fig3. The Reference against the planetary boundaries

* File: `Fig3_reference_boundaries` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `aesa/annual.csv`, `montecarlo/annual_REF.csv`, `baseline/projection.json`, `baseline/bands_annual.csv`, `baseline/annual_by_material.csv`, `baseline/annual_by_stage.csv`
* Draft caption: (a) Annual carbon, Monte Carlo median with 50% and 90% bands, against the acquired-rights (AR) and ability-to-pay (AtP) boundaries and their zones; (b) cumulative carbon 2026-2050 with the committed range after 2050 as a hollow segment on top, the AR and AtP budgets as ticks, and three thin 100% share bars by demand band, material and stage.

### Fig4. Pathways against the boundaries

* File: `Fig4_pathways_annual` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `pathways/annual.csv`, `aesa/annual.csv`
* Draft caption: Annual carbon of the Reference, P1-P5 and TL against AR and AtP: Moderate solid bold, Ambitious the same colour thin dotted.

### Fig5. From the Reference to the theoretical limit

* File: `Fig5_waterfall` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `pathways/waterfall.csv`
* Draft caption: Cumulative carbon 2026-2050 by demand band along the sequential path Reference -> P1 ... P4 (= P5 Moderate) -> TL1 ... TL9 (= TL); negative bands outlined, hanging from the top of the positive stack; each bar ends at its net total.

### Fig6. The solution space

* File: `Fig6_solution_space` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `pathways/solution_space.csv`, `pathways/backcast.json`
* Draft caption: Cumulative level of exceedance of AR and AtP over uniform cuts of 2027-2050 floor area and of carbon per m2 (after Horup et al. 2025), with P1-P5 (Moderate filled, Ambitious hollow) and TL.

### Fig7. What moves the Reference

* File: `Fig7_tornado` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `sensitivity/tornado.csv`
* Draft caption: One-at-a-time ranges of eight inputs, the overbuild absorption timing among them: (a) cumulative carbon 2026-2050, (b) cumulative LoE AR and AtP. Not additive, not a joint interval.

### Fig8. What each lever removes

* File: `Fig8_shapley_levers` (183 mm); drawn by `figures.paper_main`
* Data: `pathways/shapley.csv`
* Draft caption: Exact Shapley value of each lever (512 subsets) on cumulative carbon 2026-2050, from the Reference: hollow bar Moderate, filled bar Ambitious, large deep-green dot TL; sorted by Ambitious.
